name: sketch-test
description: A standalone, offline, single-file sketching application for residential appraisal floor plans: exterior/interior walls, curved walls, room shapes, area definitions with GLA/basement rollups, dimensioning, symbol and text libraries, multi-page documents, image underlays, and PNG/SVG/DXF/PDF/XML exports. Runs entirely in the browser from one HTML file — no install, no server, no network access required.
